task: Compare the maximum number of private repositories allowed in the Free and Pro plans in GitHub Pricing.
answer: Both the Free and Pro plans allow an unlimited number of private repositories. On the GitHub Pricing page (https://github.com/pricing), the Free plan card states 'Unlimited public/private repositories' and the 'Compare plans' table shows 'Unlimited' in the 'Private repositories' row. GitHub Pro includes all features of GitHub Free for personal accounts (per GitHub's official plans documentation), so it also allows unlimited private repositories. Free vs Pro private repository limit: Unlimited vs Unlimited (equal).
